verdicts.decision_note: The failed Google Drive link establishes the implementation-relevant acceptance condition that the recipient must be able to open and view the shared video.
This is the first concrete failure showing that the recipient could not use the shared video link.
This is a target-specific post-failure claim that the replacement link works and its permissions allow recipients with the link to view the file.
Direct in-chat delivery supersedes shared-link delivery for the task, making the existing shared_link_access condition obsolete; the removed key exists in prior state and does not overlap an update.
